summary: Comprehensive frontend+backend testing of Rezygnacja/Zastanawia się statuses, SurgeryConfirmModal flow, per-procedure control intervals, and calendar cancellation behavior. All 7 requested feature areas verified end-to-end. 0 critical or minor bugs found.

design_issues.issue: Persisting React hydration console errors: '<span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>' and '<span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' — caused by visual-editor injected <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers around <option>/<tr> nodes. Non-functional dev tooling artifact (same as iteration_4). LOW.

SurgeryConfirmModal: Modal auto-opens on / after login with 15 pending planned patients (sessionStorage cleared)
Renders 15 rows, each with surgery-performed-<id> and surgery-not-performed-<id> buttons
'Przypomnij później' (surgery-confirm-later) closes modal; stays closed after navigation to /patients and back to /
Fresh test patient (planned, surgery_date=today) → click Odbył się → GET /api/patients/{id} returns status='operated' (surgery_date preserved)
Fresh test patient → click Nie odbył się → status='awaiting', surgery_date=None
PatientsList: Default view hides operated+cancelled; 'Ukryto: Zoperowani, Rezygnacje — Pokaż' hint chip (hidden-statuses-hint) visible
Clicking show-hidden-statuses applies filter (hint hidden, filtered rows appear)
Inline status change: status-badge-<id> click → status-option-<id>-thinking → badge shows 'Zastanawia się'
Inline change to cancelled shows confirm dialog, patient disappears from default list, API confirms status='cancelled' + surgery_date=null
PatientDetail: edit-patient-button opens modal; status-select contains all 6 options: consultation, planned, awaiting, thinking, operated, cancelled
Submitting cancelled from edit modal persists status='cancelled', surgery_date=null, cancelled_surgery_date=<original date>
cancelled-surgery-date badge ('Anulowany termin') visible on detail page after cancel
detail-status-badge click opens detail-status-dropdown; detail-status-option-thinking changes badge to 'Zastanawia się'
Bug fix verified: editing an operated patient (status=operated, surgery_date set) with no status change and submitting keeps status=operated (previously forced to planned)
Settings: add-procedure-type-button opens modal with 6 presets (control-preset-7,14,30,90,180,365) and 5 default interval rows
Toggling control-preset-30 off reduces rows to 4; toggle on restores
add-control-interval adds new row; filling days=45 label='6 tygodni' persists via submit-procedure-type
New TEST_ProcedureType created via API; procedure-controls-<id> chip container shows all interval labels
Editing existing 'Septoplastyka' opens modal with exactly 2 rows (1 tydzień, 1 rok)
delete-procedure-<id> removes the created test procedure
Controls: /controls page loads without errors; 26 patients rendered via GET /api/controls/patients
Septoplastyka operated patient shows exactly 2 controls with type '7d'/'365d' and correct labels
Calendar_Dashboard: Dashboard on / renders 'Zastanawiają się' stats row

critical_code_review_comments: React hydration errors from visual-editor injected wrappers around <option>/<tr> nodes remain (cosmetic, dev-only tooling)

success_rate.backend: 100% (all pending-surgery-confirmations, surgery-outcome, procedure-types with control_intervals, controls complete/uncomplete, patient cancellation flows verified)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (SurgeryConfirmModal, PatientsList hidden hint + inline status, PatientDetail edit modal + clickable badge, Settings procedure intervals editor, Controls page, Calendar page all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created & fully cleaned up several TEST_ patients (TEST Performed, TEST NotPerformed, TESTINLINE Case, TESTDET Detail, TESTOP Operated, TESTCTL Septo, TESTCTL2 Septo) and one TEST_ProcedureType. No residual test data.
